_comment: The 3D views, built by cave-viewer (cd web && python -m caveviewer build caves.json --out ../site), from the centrelines tools/build_inputs.sh makes with cavern (web/*.3d). The LiDAR is in web/lidar/. See cave-viewer's caveviewer/schema.json for every key.

site.title: Northern England caves in 3D
site.lede: The Three Counties System, Kingsdale, White Scar, Chapel-le-Dale and Fountains Fell, from the Cave Registry Data Archive's NorthernEngland Survex data, in 3D beneath the Environment Agency's LiDAR.

defaults.notice: The routes are worked out by computer from the survey’s centreline: they show which passages join, not how to get through them. They don’t know about the pitches, squeezes, climbs, water or digs on the way, so they’re no guide for a trip.
